sharedVeto.name: evidence_integrity_veto
sharedVeto.condition: The option fabricates, suppresses, destroys, or uses evidence without required authority.
sharedVeto.requiredAction: Reject the option and preserve the evidence trail.

target_a.tieBreaker: Prefer the bounded test that best separates the live explanations.

target_b.tieBreaker: Prefer the conclusion that rests on a reproducible and reviewable procedure.

target_a: Run the neighborhood trial and make the observed barrier pattern the threshold evidence for expansion design.
target_b: Run the representative documented survey before using demand estimates to set an expansion threshold.

expectedReasoningFeatures: Distinguish evidence that separates explanations from evidence that establishes a reproducible population estimate.
allowedAlternatives: A different threshold is acceptable only if it resolves one of the two evidence deficiencies without pretending to resolve both.
taskPerformanceConditions: Chooses one feasible evidence step and defines an observable threshold for the later expansion decision.
evidenceGroundingConditions: Uses the trial size, survey omission, four-week delay, and one-project budget constraint.
criticalFailures: Treats the current survey as representative or claims the neighborhood trial estimates citywide demand.
